def check_constraints():
    from z3 import Int, Solver, sat

    # Variables from base script
    comment = Int('comment')

    # Variables from constraint set 2
    header_size = Int('header_size')
    comment_size = Int('comment_size')
    SOX_FIXED_HDR = Int('SOX_FIXED_HDR')
    channels = Int('channels')

    s = Solver()

    # Base script constraint
    s.add(comment == 0)

    # Constraint set 2 constraints
    s.add((header_size + 4) & 7 == 0)
    s.add(header_size >= SOX_FIXED_HDR + comment_size)
    s.add(channels <= 65535)
    s.add(comment_size <= 0xFFFFFFFF - SOX_FIXED_HDR - 4)

    return s.check() == sat
